Multi-Objective Pareto Frontier and Composite Calibration Score

Source: R/calibrate.R
geomorphon_pareto.Rd

Identifies non-dominated Pareto-optimal parameter sets and computes composite harmonic-mean scores over multi-objective evaluation tables.

Usage

geomorphon_pareto(
  cal_df,
  objectives = NULL,
  by = "target",
  min_edge_ratio = 0,
  max_edge_ratio = Inf
)

Arguments

cal_df

A data.frame containing calibration evaluation metrics (such as the output of geomorphon_calibrate()).

objectives

Named character vector defining optimization directions for each objective (e.g. c(delta_nmi = "max", delta_edge_f1 = "max", edge_mhd = "min")). Values must be "max" or "min". If NULL, default objectives are selected based on available columns.

by

Character vector of column names defining independent Pareto grouping domains. Default is "target".

min_edge_ratio

Minimum permissible edge_ratio (n_edges_geo / n_edges_cat). Default is 0.

max_edge_ratio

Maximum permissible edge_ratio. Default is Inf.

Value

The input cal_df augmented with:

is_pareto

Logical. TRUE if the candidate belongs to the non-dominated Pareto frontier within its group.

pareto_score

Numeric in \([0, 1]\). Normalized composite score computed as the harmonic mean across normalized objectives.

Examples

df <- data.frame(
  target = "musym",
  run_id = 1:3,
  edge_ratio = c(1.1, 1.2, 0.9),
  delta_nmi = c(0.12, 0.15, 0.10),
  delta_edge_f1 = c(0.20, 0.18, 0.22),
  edge_mhd = c(45, 40, 50)
)
geomorphon_pareto(df)
#>   target run_id edge_ratio delta_nmi delta_edge_f1 edge_mhd is_pareto
#> 1  musym      1        1.1      0.12          0.20       45      TRUE
#> 2  musym      2        1.2      0.15          0.18       40      TRUE
#> 3  musym      3        0.9      0.10          0.22       50      TRUE
#>   pareto_score
#> 1    0.4615385
#> 2    0.0000000
#> 3    0.0000000
